title: Two-DOF reacher
prompt: Design a tabletop manipulator that touches a target at (0.20, 0.00, 0.10) meters in the world frame. The base is fixed at the origin, with its lowest contact in the XY plane (z = 0). Use at least two actuated revolute joints. Each link's mass must be under 0.5 kg, and each joint's torque ceiling is 5 N·m. The end-effector link must be tagged 'tip'. The arm must reach the target without any link colliding with the table (z = 0 plane), the base, or itself. Output a complete .vcad assembly with body, joints, materials, and an initial pose; the grader will solve forward kinematics to find a configuration that reaches the target.
